• `/help` — full command list

setup.title: 🚀 Purgito initial setup
setup.body:
I'll walk you through the essential settings. Use the menu below to go through each category:

**1. Language** — pick the bot's language 🌐
**2. Chat** — decide whether the bot replies when mentioned 💬

The rest of the configuration (channels, learning, frequency, reactions, phrases, limits) is done from your dashboard: {url}

Once you pick channels for the corpus, run `/refeed_channels` so the bot learns their history. You can come back to this panel anytime with `/settings`.
setup.panel_cta: 💻 **Web panel:** configure everything from the browser — includes a visual embed editor and interactive buttons: {url}

help.intro.title: 📖 What is Purgito?
help.intro.description:
**Purgito** is the server's bot: it learns to talk like the community using Markov chains trained on the server's own messages, saves the GIFs shared in a public gallery, and lets you know when your favorite YouTube creators post new content.

From the web panel you can also build embeds and messages with interactive buttons —including buttons that assign a role— without writing code.

All commands are **slash commands** (`/`) — type `/` in chat and Discord will show you the options with autocomplete. The only exception is `!ping`, a classic text command.

Use the buttons below to see each section's commands.
help.intro.footer: Commands available in {guild} · use the buttons below

help.cat.panel.label: Web panel
help.cat.panel.intro:
These features live in the web panel ({url}), they're not slash commands.

🧩 **Embed editor** — build classic embeds (up to 10 per message) or Components V2 layouts: containers, sections, image galleries and separators.
🔘 **Interactive buttons** — add link buttons or buttons that assign/remove a role on click.
🖼️ **Images** — upload images straight from your computer or paste a URL.
💾 **Templates** — save your favorite embeds to reuse later.
